title: We Have One Heart
description: Form Animation – Narrative Premiere Status UK Country Poland Year 2020 Running Time 11min Language Polish Director Katarzyna Warzecha Screenwriter Katarzyna Warzecha Producer Ewa Jastrzębska Director of Photography Grzegorz Hartfiel Editor Piotr Kremky Sound Jakub Jerszyński Join us on a hunt like no other. Deep in the forest, a naked hunter shoots the wrong prey, but rectifying his mistake doesn’t go the way he, or we, expect. Oddly touching, this outlandish film leads us around on a merry dance, threatening to animate itself off the screen Graduating from the Krzysztof Kieślowski Film School and the Wajda School & Studio, Katarzyna Warzecha has created a superbly heartfelt new short film. A documentary about the strength of family bonds, Katarzyna uses animation and archive material to uncover a touching story of love across time and distance.
